title: Flashcards: Sharks, rays and relatives, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about sharks, rays and relatives. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Bignose Shark?
cards.explain: The Bignose Shark is Carcharhinus altimus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the oceanic whitetip shark?
cards.explain: The oceanic whitetip shark is Carcharhinus longimanus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Dusky shark?
cards.explain: The Dusky shark is Carcharhinus obscurus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the sandbar shark?
cards.explain: The sandbar shark is Carcharhinus plumbeus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the common stingray?
cards.explain: The common stingray is Dasyatis pastinaca.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Slender Hammerhead?
cards.explain: The Slender Hammerhead is Eusphyra blochii.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the sharpnose sevengill shark?
cards.explain: The sharpnose sevengill shark is Heptranchias perlo.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the horn shark?
cards.explain: The horn shark is Heterodontus francisci.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Nomititis lovulitos?
cards.explain: The Nomititis lovulitos is Hexanchus griseus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Cookie-cutter Shark?
cards.explain: The Cookie-cutter Shark is Isistius brasiliensis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the longfin mako shark?
cards.explain: The longfin mako shark is Isurus paucus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the goblin shark?
cards.explain: The goblin shark is Mitsukurina owstoni.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the common smooth-hound?
cards.explain: The common smooth-hound is Mustelus mustelus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the smalltooth sand tiger?
cards.explain: The smalltooth sand tiger is Odontaspis ferox.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the whale shark?
cards.explain: The whale shark is Rhincodon typus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the spiny dogfish shark?
cards.explain: The spiny dogfish shark is Squalus acanthias.
